test_case.test_name: Variant-bound 60-minute PCIe path bandwidth stress and health validation
test_case.purpose: Exercise the explicitly mapped PCIe data path for the approved direction and 60-minute measurement window, demonstrating signed sustained bandwidth while negotiated links, endpoints and platform health remain stable.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and exclusion of same-code AC-cycle row
Approved bandwidth tool/module version/hash/license and exact path-specific command
Direction, payload/block size, queue/concurrency, affinity, warm-up, 60-minute measurement and repetition semantics
Project throughput/variance plus AER/retrain/device/thermal/power abort limits and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the exact tool, traffic path, workload geometry and authoritative performance oracle. Once signed, preserve baseline topology/logs/health, verify workload isolation and approval, run the exact command once for its full warm-up and 60-minute measurement window, collect raw interval bandwidth plus synchronized LnkSta, AER/device/driver, temperature, power and throttle evidence, and stop without retry at the first signed abort condition.
test_case.expected_result: The approved traffic traverses the exact mapped endpoints/path in the signed direction for the complete measurement window; interval and aggregate bandwidth meet the path-specific threshold/variance; generation/width remain stable; no prohibited retrain, error, thermal/power limit or device/service fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while endpoint/path, tool/command, workload geometry or project throughput/health oracle is TBD. After approval, tool failure, incomplete duration, bandwidth/variance breach, link downgrade/retrain, device loss, AER/driver fault, thermal/power limit or performance collapse is FAIL. A one-shot value, theoretical lane rate or unrelated RDMA result cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until composite identity, mapped endpoints/path, exact tool/command, 60-minute workload, thresholds, maintenance isolation and recovery are signed.
Drain competing workloads and confirm cooling/power capacity plus operator/console recovery before sustained traffic.
Preserve logs; no link-setting change, code-only dispatch, AC cycle, output truncation, duration reduction, automatic retry or recovery.
Abort once on device disappearance, downgrade/retrain, AER/XID/driver fault, hang, thermal/power breach or sustained performance collapse.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 2209 AC Cycle
Tool/module identity, version/hash/license and complete approved command/recipe
Endpoint UUID/serial/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer/NUMA topology with pre/post generation/width
Raw interval throughput, direction, payload/concurrency, warm-up and full 60-minute timestamps
Synchronized AER/device/driver/OS/BMC, temperature, power and throttle evidence with exit status
Abort/recovery record, comparison to signed performance/health oracle and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first endpoint, link, error, thermal/power or performance anomaly, stop the workload once and preserve all evidence. Keep the affected path quiesced and use only the signed operator/vendor recovery after health review; do not power-cycle, reset links/devices or rerun automatically.
